product_one_liner.value: Harmony Healthcare IT’s cloud-hosted HealthData Platform helps healthcare organizations securely retain, access and share patient, employee and business records.

pricing_page.notes: The page describes standard, enterprise and SaaS pricing models without publishing dollar prices.

named_customers.notes: Both are documented in customer case studies.

hq_location.notes: Headquarters address: 3454 Douglas Road, South Bend, Indiana 46635.

eng_blog.notes: The reviewed indexes show industry guidance and customer/product content, not two engineer-authored posts explaining how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The public Blue Elm tutorial library includes Conversions, DR Dashboard, DR Auditor and OpenGate documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: None of the six listed openings has a qualifying AI, ML or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: No specific model or provider was disclosed in the reviewed product materials, technical resources, AI content, security FAQ, trust resources or privacy policy; ClearWay is described only as using AI and NLP.

compliance_certs.notes: These are the claims listed from the five requested categories; HIPAA is a compliance claim rather than a formal certification.

last_funding.notes: The latest recorded investment is from Novacap, announced November 28, 2023; the amount was not disclosed.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest recorded investment, November 28, 2023, predates the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The six listed openings include Business Development Director roles, but no SDR, BDR or account-executive titles.

launched_6mo.notes: No qualifying launch was found for May 9–November 9, 2026 in the reviewed history. The located ClearWay launch announcement predates the window; Harmony Ignite pages did not establish a launch date.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Brian Liddell was appointed CEO effective April 30, 2026; Matt Cook’s CTO appointment was announced March 24, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Sales postings explicitly describe Sugar CRM and Definitive Healthcare usage. Salesforce is mentioned as preferred prior experience, not confirmed deployment.
